international.title: Vape users hospitalised after losing consciousness, prompting public health warning in New South Wales
international.summary: NSW health issues public warning about vape liquids containing etomidate, a strong and fast-acting sedative used as a general anaesthetic overseas Three people who lost consciousness and were hospitalised in New South Wales after using certain vapes have tested positive for the unregulated anaesthetic agent etomidate, health officials have said. NSW health on Friday issued a public warning about vape liquids containing etomidate, a strong and fast-acting sedative used as a general anaesthetic overseas but not registered for medical use in Australia.
